conferences.speaker: NeurIPS mentors and student volunteers
conferences.topic: ML Fundamentals, Research Pathways, AI Careers
conferences.desc: NeurIPS hosts outreach sessions specifically for high school students — panel discussions, Q&A with researchers, and introductory ML demos. Free to join virtually; check the NeurIPS site for each year's schedule.

conferences.name: Stanford HAI — Human-Centered AI Symposium
conferences.speaker: Stanford HAI fellows and industry leaders
conferences.topic: Human-AI Collaboration, AI Policy, Foundation Models
conferences.desc: Stanford's interdisciplinary AI institute hosts public symposiums bringing together technologists, ethicists, policymakers, and domain experts. Livestreamed for free — high-quality debate on where AI is heading.

volunteering.name: NeurIPS Student Volunteer Program
volunteering.speaker: Various top ML researchers worldwide
volunteering.topic: Deep Learning, RL, AI Safety, Alignment

volunteering.name: Google Developer Student Clubs (GDSC) — Lead or Member
volunteering.speaker: Student-led, Google-sponsored
volunteering.topic: AI, Cloud, Mobile, Web — hands-on community projects

volunteering.name: MLH (Major League Hacking) — Hackathon Organizer / Coach
volunteering.speaker: MLH Community
volunteering.topic: Hackathon organization, mentoring, and judging

volunteering.name: Code.org — Volunteer Educator & Facilitator
volunteering.speaker: Code.org volunteers
volunteering.topic: CS and AI education outreach for K-12 students

volunteering.name: AI for Good Foundation — Youth Ambassador
volunteering.speaker: ITU / AI for Good team
volunteering.topic: AI policy, SDGs, global development advocacy

volunteering.name: FIRST Robotics — Student Mentor / Alumni Coach
volunteering.speaker: FIRST alumni community
volunteering.topic: Robotics, AI systems, STEM mentorship

volunteering.name: ICLR Student Volunteer Program
volunteering.speaker: ICLR organizing committee
volunteering.topic: Deep learning research, conference logistics, networking
volunteering.desc: Volunteer at one of the most prestigious ML conferences in exchange for free registration (worth $500+). Help with sessions, Q&A, and workshops — and get direct access to top researchers and their talks.

volunteering.name: Women in Machine Learning (WiML) Workshop Volunteer
volunteering.speaker: WiML organizing team
volunteering.topic: Inclusive AI research, mentoring, community building
volunteering.desc: WiML runs a major workshop at NeurIPS connecting women and non-binary researchers in ML. Volunteering provides mentorship, community, and exposure to outstanding women in AI research — open to all gender identities.

volunteering.name: Black in AI — Workshop Volunteer & Community Member
volunteering.speaker: Black in AI organizing committee
volunteering.org: Black in AI · Co-located with NeurIPS
volunteering.topic: Representation in AI, research mentorship, policy
volunteering.desc: Black in AI's annual workshop and social is one of the best-networked events in ML. Volunteers help with logistics, panels, and mentorship sessions. A powerful community for underrepresented students entering AI.

volunteering.name: AI4ALL Open Learning — Curriculum Volunteer
volunteering.speaker: AI4ALL educators
volunteering.topic: K-12 AI education, curriculum development, inclusion
volunteering.desc: AI4ALL trains the next generation of diverse AI leaders. As a volunteer, you can contribute to curriculum, mentor summer program participants, or support their Open Learning initiative — free AI education for underrepresented students.

volunteering.name: Girls Who Code — Club Facilitator / Volunteer Instructor
volunteering.speaker: Girls Who Code educators
volunteering.topic: CS fundamentals, Python, web development, ML basics
volunteering.desc: Run a GWC club at your school or volunteer at after-school sessions teaching coding to girls. Hands-on curriculum includes Python and intro ML projects — impactful, flexible, and easy to set up.

volunteering.name: Hour of Code — Volunteer Educator
volunteering.speaker: Code.org community
volunteering.topic: CS introductory activities, AI concepts, computational thinking
volunteering.desc: Code.org's Hour of Code happens every December in schools worldwide. As a volunteer, you lead 1-hour coding activities in classrooms. Minimal prep time, immediate impact, and many schools specifically request AI-focused volunteers.

volunteering.name: Kaggle — Community Forum Mentor & Notebook Author
volunteering.speaker: Kaggle community
volunteering.topic: ML competitions, data science, model evaluation
volunteering.desc: Earning Kaggle Expert or Master tier through competition contributions and published notebooks is a recognized signal to AI employers. Active mentorship in discussion forums also builds your ML community presence.

volunteering.name: Latinas in AI — Ambassador & Event Volunteer
volunteering.speaker: Latinas in AI leadership
volunteering.topic: AI leadership, representation, mentorship
volunteering.desc: A community focused on increasing Latina representation in AI. Volunteer opportunities include event coordination, workshop facilitation, and social media outreach. Strong network of AI professionals across the Americas.

volunteering.name: Partnership on AI — Student Working Group
volunteering.speaker: PAI research staff
volunteering.topic: AI governance, responsible AI practices, policy
volunteering.desc: PAI brings together AI researchers, academics, and NGOs to develop AI best practices. Student researchers can contribute to reports, attend roundtables, and engage with policy discussions — excellent for AI ethics tracks.

volunteering.name: IEEE Student Branch — AI/ML Section Lead
volunteering.speaker: IEEE volunteers
volunteering.topic: Technical projects, AI engineering, professional development
volunteering.desc: Starting or leading an IEEE student branch at your school gives you IEEE membership, access to research papers, and a professional network. Organize AI/ML project demos, speaker events, and hackathons.

volunteering.name: ACM Student Chapter — Organizer
volunteering.speaker: ACM community
volunteering.topic: Computing, algorithms, AI research, coding competitions
volunteering.desc: ACM chapters run programming contests, reading groups, and speaker series. ACM membership provides free digital library access — thousands of ML papers. Leadership roles in ACM chapters look strong on research applications.

volunteering.name: Papers with Code — Open Source ML Contributor
volunteering.speaker: ML community
volunteering.topic: Reproducing ML results, code documentation, benchmarks
volunteering.desc: Papers with Code links ML papers to their GitHub implementations and benchmark leaderboards. Contributing reproductions, benchmark results, or documentation is a direct way to engage with the ML research community.

volunteering.name: Teach AI — K-12 AI Curriculum Contributor
volunteering.speaker: ISTE/CSTA volunteer educators
volunteering.topic: AI literacy, K-12 education, lesson plan development
volunteering.desc: Teach AI develops AI literacy frameworks for K-12 education. As a volunteer, you can contribute lesson plans, review curriculum content, or speak at teacher professional development sessions.

volunteering.name: AAAI Student Volunteer Program
volunteering.speaker: AAAI organizing committee
volunteering.topic: AI research, conference experience, broad AI topics
volunteering.desc: AAAI accepts student volunteers for conference logistics in exchange for free registration. One of the broadest AI conferences — great for students who want exposure beyond deep learning to planning, knowledge representation, and multi-agent systems.

summerSchools.name: Stanford HAI / AIMI Summer Research Program
summerSchools.desc: Research mentorship in Human-Centered AI and AI in Medicine. Access to Stanford faculty and labs.

summerSchools.name: UC Berkeley AI4ALL
summerSchools.desc: Residential AI summer camp at UC Berkeley focused on social impact. Competitive application; financial aid available.

summerSchools.name: MIT PRIMES (Program for Research in Mathematics, Engineering & Science)
summerSchools.desc: Year-long mentored research program for high schoolers, including AI/CS projects with MIT researchers.

summerSchools.name: Carnegie Mellon SAMS (Summer Academy for Math and Science)
summerSchools.desc: 6-week residential STEM program at CMU. Covers AI, ML, robotics, and CS fundamentals.

summerSchools.name: NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute (DLI) Summer Programs
summerSchools.desc: Hands-on GPU-accelerated training workshops in DL, CV, and NLP. Certificate upon completion.

summerSchools.name: Google CS Research Mentorship Program (CSRMP)
summerSchools.desc: Connects underrepresented students with Google researchers for 12-week mentored projects.

summerSchools.name: Oxford Machine Learning Summer School (OxML)
summerSchools.org: University of Oxford / AI for Global Goals
summerSchools.desc: One of the most competitive ML summer schools in the world. Led by Oxford researchers — covers deep learning, NLP, computer vision, and RL with a strong mathematical foundation. Scholarships available for students from lower-income countries.

summerSchools.name: Eastern European Machine Learning Summer School (EEML)
summerSchools.org: Organized by DeepMind / Google Brain researchers
summerSchools.desc: A highly selective summer school run by DeepMind and Google Brain researchers for students in Eastern Europe and globally. Known for exceptional lab sessions and direct access to industry ML researchers.

summerSchools.name: AI4ALL Summer Program
summerSchools.desc: A paid, fully-funded residential AI program for underrepresented high school students. Runs at multiple university campuses, with a focus on building both technical skills and understanding AI's social impact.

summerSchools.name: Google CS Summer Institute (CSSI)
summerSchools.desc: Google's 3-week introductory CS program specifically for incoming college freshmen from underrepresented groups. Covers web development, Python, and CS fundamentals — held at Google campuses. Paid and fully funded.

summerSchools.name: CMU RISS — Robotics Institute Summer Scholars
summerSchools.desc: CMU's flagship robotics research internship — 10 weeks working directly with CMU robotics faculty on real research projects. One of the strongest undergraduate robotics research programs in the world; strong AI component.

summerSchools.name: MIT PRIMES-Circle
summerSchools.desc: MIT PRIMES-Circle connects MIT student mentors with local high school students for hands-on math and CS projects. A lower barrier version of the highly selective PRIMES research program — all projects are MIT-mentored.

summerSchools.name: Caltech SURF — Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship
summerSchools.desc: Caltech's prestigious 10-week research fellowship matching undergraduates with Caltech faculty, including AI and computational science labs. Strong alumni network; many SURF participants go on to top PhD programs.

summerSchools.name: NSF REU — AI & Machine Learning Track
summerSchools.desc: NSF funds 1,000+ summer research positions at universities across the US, many with AI/ML focus. Students receive a stipend, housing, and direct faculty mentorship. A major pathway to PhD programs at top schools.

summerSchools.name: Veritas AI — High School Research Program
summerSchools.desc: An intensive summer AI research program founded by Harvard and MIT students specifically for high schoolers. Projects range from ML for healthcare to NLP — students produce a publishable research paper with faculty mentorship.

summerSchools.name: Inspirit AI — Stanford & MIT-Founded Program
summerSchools.desc: Founded by Stanford and MIT graduates, Inspirit AI teaches students to build real AI projects through project-based curriculum. Offers both live online and on-campus formats; students complete 2–3 portfolio projects.

summerSchools.name: NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute (DLI) — Summer Intensive
summerSchools.desc: NVIDIA's official hands-on DL training program. Courses on GPU computing, computer vision, NLP, and robotics. Some community college partnerships offer free access — check for student pricing and scholarship codes.

summerSchools.name: Johns Hopkins Center for Talented Youth — AI Track
summerSchools.desc: JHU CTY is one of the most established gifted education programs in the US, running for 40+ years. The AI and ML courses provide a rigorous introduction to algorithms and neural networks with hands-on project work.

summerSchools.name: Columbia Pre-College — AI & Machine Learning Intensive
summerSchools.org: Columbia University School of Professional Studies
summerSchools.desc: Columbia's pre-college AI program runs in NYC over 3 weeks. Students take university-level AI courses, use Columbia's research computing cluster, and gain early exposure to university research culture and NYC tech industry.

summerSchools.name: Polygence — Mentored AI Research Project
summerSchools.desc: Polygence matches high school students with PhD student mentors for 1-on-1 original research projects. AI/ML tracks are among the most popular — students produce a paper, presentation, or public project over 10+ sessions.

researchPrograms.name: Spirit AI High School Research Program
researchPrograms.desc: One of the few mentored AI research programs designed specifically for high schoolers. Real publication potential.

researchPrograms.name: RSI — Research Science Institute
researchPrograms.org: MIT / Center for Excellence in Education
researchPrograms.desc: 6-week on-campus research at MIT — one of the most prestigious science programs in the world. Highly competitive.

researchPrograms.name: PRIMES-USA
researchPrograms.desc: Remote version of MIT PRIMES. Year-long research mentorship with MIT faculty in CS, AI, and math.

researchPrograms.name: Regeneron Science Talent Search
researchPrograms.desc: The most prestigious pre-college science competition in the US. Top AI/ML projects have won national recognition.

researchPrograms.name: Simons Summer Research Program
researchPrograms.desc: 7-week mentored research experience at Stony Brook with faculty in STEM fields including AI.

researchPrograms.name: UCSB Research Mentorship Program (RMP)
researchPrograms.desc: 5-week residential research mentorship with UCSB faculty including AI and computational science projects.

researchPrograms.name: MIT UROP — Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program
researchPrograms.desc: MIT's flagship program connecting undergrads to faculty research from freshman year. Many MIT students in AI/ML publish papers through UROP — a foundational reason MIT undergrads are so competitive for PhD programs.

researchPrograms.name: Stanford CURIS — Computer Science Undergraduate Research
researchPrograms.desc: Stanford's summer CS research fellowship — includes AI, ML, HCI, and systems. Non-Stanford students can apply competitively. 10-week stipend-supported position working directly with faculty or PhD mentors.

researchPrograms.name: Google Research — Student Researcher Program
researchPrograms.desc: Google's part-time student research program — work remotely on a real Google Research project while enrolled in school. Unlike an internship, it continues during the semester. Highly competitive and increasingly the pipeline to Google AI full-time roles.

researchPrograms.name: Microsoft Research — Internship (MSRI)
researchPrograms.desc: Microsoft Research internships are a direct path to some of the most impactful AI research in industry. Labs include MSR Cambridge, MSR Redmond, MSR Asia — many papers published from MSRI lead to top-tier publications.

researchPrograms.name: Lumiere Research Scholar Program
researchPrograms.desc: Lumiere pairs high school students with PhD student mentors from top universities for 12-week independent research projects. AI/ML is among the most popular tracks — students produce publishable papers with strong mentor support.

researchPrograms.name: Aether Research — AI Research Program for High Schoolers
researchPrograms.desc: A mentored AI research program run by graduate students at top universities. Combines curriculum in ML fundamentals with original research projects. Strong track record of student papers accepted at AI conferences.

researchPrograms.name: CMU Dietrich College Undergraduate Research
researchPrograms.desc: CMU's umbrella undergraduate research program — covers SCS, MLD, and Robotics Institute labs. CMU's AI faculty (in language technologies, computer vision, and RL) run active research groups that frequently take undergrads.

researchPrograms.name: Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Lab (APL) — SEAP
researchPrograms.org: Johns Hopkins APL / US Department of Defense
researchPrograms.desc: SEAP places high school students in cutting-edge research at JHU APL, which conducts AI research for national defense, space exploration, and healthcare. Paid 8-week program — one of the best-funded HS research experiences in the US.

researchPrograms.name: Simons Summer Research Program
researchPrograms.desc: 7-week residential research program at Stony Brook University. Students work 1-on-1 with SBU faculty in labs including AI/ML and computational science. Culminates in a symposium — strong preparation for science fair competitions.

researchPrograms.name: AI Camp — Intensive Research Track
researchPrograms.desc: AI Camp offers hands-on AI project bootcamps for high schoolers. The research track produces real deployable projects — students have built ML applications for climate science, accessibility, and healthcare, mentored by ML engineers.

researchPrograms.name: LabXchange — Harvard-Founded Research Simulation Platform
researchPrograms.desc: Harvard-developed platform for virtual science and AI research simulations. Free to use — students can engage in mentor-guided research clusters with real Harvard researchers through the online community.

researchPrograms.name: PRIMES-USA — Remote Math & CS Research
researchPrograms.desc: The remote version of MIT PRIMES — open to students anywhere in the US. Students work 1-on-1 with MIT student mentors on original math or CS research projects, including AI/ML theory. One of the most academically rigorous HS research programs.

researchPrograms.name: Wolfram Research Internship
researchPrograms.desc: Wolfram hires exceptional high school students as research interns. Projects involve Mathematica, Wolfram Language, and increasingly AI/ML tools. Alumni have contributed to Wolfram|Alpha and Wolfram Language AI features.

researchPrograms.name: Research Science Institute (RSI) — MIT
researchPrograms.org: Center for Excellence in Education / MIT
researchPrograms.desc: The most selective free research program in the US — MIT-hosted, fully funded, 6 weeks of original STEM research with MIT and Harvard faculty mentors. RSI alumni include 2+ Nobel laureates and dozens of Intel/Regeneron winners.
